item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. This is the scale of change we must prepare for.

2. We see superintelligent AI as an engine of extraordinary economic growth. If it is built within the next 20 years, global output will at least double in the following decade. We must make that prosperity broadly shared.

3. We must plan for an economic transformation, not business as usual. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years. We must prepare our institutions for that future.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We see this as a transformation in our capacity to discover, invent and produce, with consequences for every sector of the economy. We must start preparing now, not wait until that transformation is underway. We must build institutions that turn extraordinary productive capacity into widely shared prosperity, stronger public services and greater opportunity. We know that doubling output and distributing its benefits are different tasks. We must pursue both, making economic growth serve people rather than treating growth alone as the finish line.
